title: Jobwatch: a VS Code extension showing Hugging Face Jobs and their estimated cost in the status bar
description:
A Visual Studio Code extension that watches Hugging Face Jobs from the status bar: which jobs are queued or running, their estimated cost so far, and this month's estimated spend.

It notifies once when a job fails (naming an out-of-memory kill as such), completes, nears its own time limit or waits too long for hardware, and when spend passes a monthly budget. Cost is estimated from running time and the provider's own per-minute price list. Because the provider records no end time for a cancelled job, the extension substitutes the last time it observed the job running, and bounds jobs it never observed by their time limits rather than guessing.

Read-only, with no runtime dependencies and no telemetry. Unofficial; not affiliated with Hugging Face. MIT licence.
